description: How shippers, carriers, and freight operations relate to each other: who awards and brokers freight, who tenders and executes loads, how audited invoices and quick-pay settle, and which visibility loops keep the network improving.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Awarding contract lanes and outsourcing managed transportation

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day tendering, booking, and execution of shipments

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Freight audit, invoice settlement, and fast carrier payment

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Shipment visibility, exception alerts, and network performance feedback

relations.name: Awards contract lanes
relations.description: Runs procurement events and awards contract lanes and rates to carriers, setting the routing guide that daily tendering follows.

relations.name: Outsources managed transportation
relations.description: Contracts brokers and managed-transportation providers to plan, cover, and monitor freight the in-house team cannot or does not want to run itself.

relations.name: Tenders and books loads
relations.description: Tenders loads to vetted carriers, negotiates spot cover when the routing guide fails, and books appointments and load details for execution.

relations.name: Executes pickups and deliveries
relations.description: Hauls the shipper's freight against tendered loads, meeting facility appointment windows and returning signed proof of delivery.

relations.name: Streams status and documents
relations.description: Sends tracking updates, delay notifications, and documents such as BOLs and PODs so operations can manage exceptions instead of chasing check calls.

relations.name: Provides control-tower visibility
relations.description: Surfaces shipment status, exceptions, and customer-ready updates in the control tower so the shipper protects service levels without manual tracking.

relations.name: Settles audited freight invoices
relations.description: Audits carrier invoices against contracted rates and accessorials and settles them, disputing mismatches before payment leaves the door.

relations.name: Pays carriers fast
relations.description: Pays carriers for brokered loads with quick-pay options and clean paperwork, protecting small fleets' cash flow and keeping capacity loyal.

relations.name: Feeds back facility experience
relations.description: Reports detention, dwell, and facility issues that shippers use to fix problem locations and stay a carrier-preferred network.
